mapper.select: select c.conversation_id, c.visitor_id, c.scene, c.title, c.create_time, c.update_time, (select count(*) from ai_chat_message m where m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id) as message_count, (select m2.content from ai_chat_message m2 where m2.conversation_id = c.conversation_id order by m2.message_id desc limit 1) as last_message from ai_chat_conversation c where c.visitor_id = #{visitorId} and c.scene = #{scene} order by c.update_time desc, c.conversation_id desc limit 100
mapper.update: update ai_chat_conversation set title = #{title}, update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: select message_id, conversation_id, role, content, intent, intent_confidence, needs_clarification, sources_json, create_time from ai_chat_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by message_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_chat_message ( conversation_id, role, content, intent, intent_confidence, needs_clarification, sources_json, create_time ) values ( #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{intent}, #{intentConfidence}, #{needsClarification}, #{sourcesJson}, sysdate() )
